OWNER CONTROL CENTER

Settings

Manage the products, personnel, inventory controls and business rules used throughout Solavida POS.

💧 Products & Pricing

Control what staff can sell and the default prices.

ProductUnitWalk-InDeliveryStatus
Changing a default price affects future transactions. Existing completed sales keep their recorded price.

🫙 Container Types

Add container shapes or sizes and set a price adjustment for each. Round and Slim start at the same price.

Price adjustment is added to the customer's normal product price. Keep both at ₱0.00 to charge the same price. For example, Slim can have a ₱5.00 adjustment later without changing the Round price.
Container TypeExtra per containerStatus

👥 Personnel

Manage employees, flexible job roles and system access.

NameJob Role(s)System AccessMobileLoginStatus
The employee record is used for attribution. Job roles and additional system access can be assigned after the employee is created.

🛠 Job Roles

Create the operational roles used by this business. These are separate from system access.

Job RoleDescriptionStatus

🔐 System Access & Permissions

Owner-defined system access. An employee may have more than one access role, such as Staff + Auditor.

Job Role describes what a person does. System Access controls what they can do inside the POS. Permission changes are saved here and will be used as we finish wiring module access controls.
PermissionModuleAllow

Track the physical assets that move through Solavida operations.

Container ManagementContainer codes, issued to customers, returned, lost, damaged and current status will be managed here.
Dispenser ManagementTrack dispenser codes, customer assignment, released/returned status, lost or damaged units.
